domaine.lead: Two hectares of meadows on the edge of the forest, at a place called Vogelsgesang, and everything there is to see within an hour.
p: Set in a vast, green two-hectare estate on the edge of the forest, our two gîtes occupy the lower floor of a spacious house in an exceptional spot known as “Vogelsgesang” — birdsong.
Typical of the Lorraine countryside, the surroundings offer lush nature and a beautiful panorama, in an atmosphere of calm and serenity.
There are many walking trails, reachable without crossing a road, on foot or by bike. Our horses, now retired, will watch you go by from the meadow.

faq.lead: Answers to the questions we are asked most often before a booking. For anything else, an e-mail or a phone call is enough.
items: How many people can stay in a gîte?

Each gîte sleeps 1 to 4 people, in two bedrooms with two 90 × 190 cm beds (which can be pushed together). An extra bed in the living room is possible on request. As the two gîtes are identical, a group can book both: up to 8 people.
Can we bring our dog or cat?
Yes, pets are welcome, two at most, at no extra charge. They will love the two-hectare estate and the forest paths that start from the garden.
Are the gîtes wheelchair accessible?
Yes. The gîtes are single-storey, at garden level, with a private entrance and an accessible shower room (walk-in shower, toilet). They hold the Tourisme & Handicap label.
Can we book for a weekend?
Yes: 2 nights (Friday to Sunday) for €300, or 3 nights (Friday to Monday) for €350. Midweek, the minimum stay is 4 nights, arriving between Sunday and Thursday.
What does the price include?

Everything except the tourist tax: electricity, water, heating, fibre Wi-Fi, parking, sheets, beds made on arrival and the final cleaning — the gîte is simply left tidy, with the dishes washed and put away. Bath towels are not provided.
How do we book and pay?

The form on the Booking page offers you the gîte that is free on your dates; we confirm within 24 hours. A 25% deposit is requested on booking, the balance on site. We accept credit cards, Visa, MasterCard and French ANCV holiday vouchers. A €300 security deposit is requested.
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in from 4 pm, check-out by 10 am. If you arrive late, let us know: we will work something out.
Is there baby equipment?
Yes: a cot, baby bath and high chair on request, at no extra charge. Just tell us when booking.
Is the Wi-Fi good?
Yes, the gîtes have a fibre connection. Wi-Fi is free and covers the apartment and the terrace.
Where can we shop?
The bakery is 300 m away, a restaurant 1 km, a grocery 3 km. The supermarkets of Creutzwald and Saint-Avold are 10 minutes away.
What is there to do around the gîte?

Walking trails start from the garden without crossing a road. Creutzwald lake and its water-sports centre are 6 km away, the Warndt forest all around; Metz, Saarbrücken and Luxembourg are day trips. See the Estate & surroundings page.
Can we smoke in the gîte?
No, the gîtes are non-smoking. The private terrace is there for that.

gite-accessible-pmr-moselle.h1: A wheelchair-accessible gîte in Moselle, in the heart of nature
gite-accessible-pmr-moselle.lead: Two single-storey gîtes with the Tourisme & Handicap label, in Varsberg, between forest and meadows.
gite-accessible-pmr-moselle.photo2_alt: The accessible shower room: walk-in shower and toilet
sections: A home designed for everyone
Our two gîtes are on the garden level of the house, single-storey, with a private entrance and a parking space by the door. No steps between the car, the terrace and the living room.

The shower room is accessible: walk-in shower, adapted toilet, room to manoeuvre. The bedrooms, living room and kitchen are open and easy to move around. The gîtes hold the Tourisme & Handicap and Gîtes de France labels.
Nature within reach

The two-hectare estate lies on the edge of the forest, at a place called Vogelsgesang — “birdsong”. The private terrace looks over the meadow; walking paths start from the garden without crossing a road.
Creutzwald lake, 6 km away, offers swimming and water sports; Saint-Avold, Metz and Saarbrücken are 15 to 40 minutes away.
Book direct
The two gîtes are identical: book whichever is free on your dates, or both for a large family. We reply within 24 hours and gladly adapt to your needs: tell us what would help.

gite-lac-de-creutzwald.h1: A gîte near Creutzwald lake, on the edge of the Warndt forest
gite-lac-de-creutzwald.lead: 6 km from the water-sports centre, two peaceful gîtes on a two-hectare estate.
sections: The lake ten minutes away

Creutzwald lake and its water-sports centre are 6 km from the gîte: supervised swimming in summer, sailing, paddle-boarding, fishing, a walk or bike ride around the lake, and a swimming pool in Creutzwald 7 km away. Tennis courts and a water park (Calypso, in Saarbrücken) complete the programme.
The Warndt forest all around

The estate sits on the hill above Varsberg, on the edge of the Warndt forest, one of the large forests of eastern Moselle. Hiking and mountain-bike trails start from the garden without crossing a road; mountain bikes are available.
In the evening, dinner is on the terrace facing the meadow, with the horses and the birdsong that gave the place its name: Vogelsgesang.
Two identical gîtes
60 m² each, 1 to 4 people, two bedrooms, fitted kitchen, accessible shower room, private terrace, fibre Wi-Fi, pets welcome. Book one of them, or both for a group.
facts: From €300 for a weekend, €420 for a week

gites-saint-avold-sarrebruck.h1: Two gîtes between Saint-Avold and Saarbrücken, in Varsberg
gites-saint-avold-sarrebruck.lead: 15 km from Saint-Avold, 30 minutes from Saarbrücken, 40 minutes from Metz: eastern Moselle in peace, a stone's throw from Germany.
gites-saint-avold-sarrebruck.photo2_alt: The fields above the estate, on the edge of the Warndt forest
sections: Well placed, and quiet

Varsberg is a village in eastern Moselle between Saint-Avold and Creutzwald, a few minutes from the A4 motorway (exit Saint-Avold / Carling) and the German border. An ideal stopover on the Paris–Strasbourg route, or a base for exploring the region.
Saint-Avold railway station (TER Metz–Forbach) is 15 km away.
Worth seeing within an hour

The Lorraine American Cemetery in Saint-Avold, the largest in Europe, 15 km away. The Völklingen ironworks, a UNESCO World Heritage site, 28 km. The Wendel mining museum in Petite-Rosselle, 31 km. The Centre Pompidou-Metz and the cathedral, 40 minutes. Saarbrücken, Luxembourg and the Bliesbruck archaeological park as day trips.
A stay in the heart of nature

Our two identical gîtes are on the garden level of the house, on a two-hectare estate on the edge of the forest: private terrace, fitted kitchen, accessible shower room, fibre Wi-Fi, pets welcome. Hosts since 2007, we speak French, German and English.
facts: From €300 for a weekend, €420 for a week
